title: Research problem for evidence-search-runtime-001
goal: Define the first evidence-search runtime slice that can produce ranked evidence packets from research problem inputs.
problem_statement: What contract and runtime should convert a research problem into ranked evidence packets with source quality and rejection traceability?

repo_context.decision_target: whether to build evidence-search-tool v1 as a bounded source discovery, normalization, ranking, and evidence packet materialization runtime
repo_context.decision_consequence: changes whether research begins with live source discovery rather than hand-seeded evidence packets
repo_context.blocked_work_if_unanswered: research quality remains limited by manually supplied evidence packets and cannot validate source discovery behavior

research_context.evidence_summary: Evidence-search v1 should use bounded query generation, source normalization, source ranking, and rejection traceability before emitting evidence packets.
